where: rewrite/plans/step-5/agents.md (M3 and the clerk rule); rewrite/spec/topics/platform-proven-2.md item 43; rewrite/spec/topics/long-commands.md
problem: When the platform moves a call to the background, its notice tells the agent: 'It is running now: do not start a second copy while it runs.' It also says: 'if you need its result, wait for it before giving your final response.' M3 and the clerk rule now tell the agent the opposite: 'run the same command again once the call is moved to the background (never poll it)'. Neither says why the re-run is safe. topics/long-commands.md reconciles the two ('a job command starts none', because the call re-attaches), but that text never reaches the agent. So the agent gets two contradicting instructions at the moment it must choose. In round 4, the s4b agent followed the platform and polled the background output. Separately, item 43 quotes the notice ('not to start a second copy') from rerun C's log. That log is temporary, under the session scratchpad at chk4/logs/C.jsonl, and CHECK.md does not quote that line, although the record's header says CHECK.md quotes the lines that decide.
proposed_resolution: Give M3 and the clerk rule the reason in a few words. For example: 'once the call is moved to the background, run the same command again; it re-attaches to the job already running and is not a second copy; do not wait for or read the background task.' The method then settles the conflict with the platform's notice instead of contradicting it. Have the orchestrator save the notice line from chk4/logs/C.jsonl into rewrite/spike/probes-round-4/ before the scratchpad is cleared, and have item 43 cite that saved file.
